display.purpose: Page titles, hero numbers, section headers. Bricolage Grotesque only.

body.purpose: All prose, labels, descriptions. Albert Sans.

label.purpose: Machine-authored or verifiable values — hashes, ledger seq numbers, region codes. Spline Sans Mono.

shadows.name: overlay
shadows.purpose: Floating content only — tooltips, dropdown menus. Never a card at rest.

shadows.name: focus-ring
shadows.purpose: Global :focus-visible state on every interactive element.

motion.name: dur
motion.purpose: Default transition duration for state changes.

motion.name: ease-brand
motion.purpose: The system's one easing curve — used by every motion-authored animation (memory trace, count-up, trust lattice, logo draw-in).

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single most important action on a screen.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: rgb(111 227 210 / 12%); color: #6FE3D2; border: 1px solid rgb(111 227 210 / 38%); border-radius: 8px; height: 2.25rem; padding: 0 0.875rem; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; font-family: 'Albert Sans', sans-serif; transition: background 0.12s cubic-bezier(0.2,0.7,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: rgb(111 227 210 / 20%); }

components.name: Destroy Button
components.description: The only solid-fill button in the system. One per destructive flow, never more.
components.css: .ds-btn-destroy { background: #E4586B; color: #12172B; border: none; border-radius: 8px; height: 2.25rem; padding: 0 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; font-family: 'Albert Sans', sans-serif; transition: background 0.12s; } .ds-btn-destroy:hover { background: rgb(228 88 107 / 90%); }

components.name: Trust Badge — Trusted
components.description: One of five trust states; color AND shape both carry meaning (filled circle = trusted).
components.html: Trusted
components.css: .ds-badge-trusted { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; border-radius: 4px; padding: 2px 8px; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; color: #6FE3D2; background: rgb(111 227 210 / 12%); border: 1px solid rgb(111 227 210 / 38%); }

components.name: Card
components.description: The base container. Flat at rest — no shadow; depth is the veil layer plus a hairline border.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #232B45; border: 1px solid #36415F; border-radius: 14px; } .ds-card-header { padding: 14px 20px; border-bottom: 1px solid #36415F; font-family: 'Bricolage Grotesque', sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; } .ds-card-body { padding: 16px 20px; }

components.name: Memory Trace
components.description: Signature component: a live SVG hash-chain of ledger commits, tinted by operation class, dashed at an erasure, heavier anchor node at a checkpoint. Draws in on mount; new commits pop with an expanding-ring highlight.
components.html: <svg class="ds-trace" viewBox="0 0 240 44"><line x1="16" y1="22" x2="42" y2="22" stroke="#36415F"/><circle cx="16" cy="22" r="3.5" fill="#6FE3D2"/><circle cx="42" cy="22" r="3.5" fill="#F2A65A"/></svg>

narrative.overview: Long-exposure neuron microscopy: deep indigo depths with bioluminescent traces moving through them. Surfaces are layered translucency rather than flat black, implying tiers beneath the one you're looking at. Color is a four-way semantic system, not a single decorative accent — a viewer should be able to read system state from a screenshot alone. The system is quiet everywhere except one place: the memory trace is the one bold, animated signature element.
keyCharacteristics: Deep indigo surfaces in three translucent layers (abyss → veil → veil-hi), never flat black
Four accent colors, each meaning exactly one system operation, never used decoratively
Flat by default — depth comes from tonal layering and hairline borders, not shadows
Signal red appears as a filled button background in exactly one place per destructive flow
Motion is restrained and purposeful, fully suppressed under prefers-reduced-motion

rules.name: The One Meaning Rule
rules.body: A color is never chosen for how it looks on a given screen. If a new element needs a color, it needs a clearer statement of what system operation it represents first.

rules.name: The Signal Scarcity Rule
rules.body: Signal red is a filled button background in exactly one place per flow — the destructive-confirm control. Everywhere else it is text, a badge outline, or a status dot.

rules.name: The Mono-Is-Semantic Rule
rules.body: Monospace marks a value a machine wrote and the system can verify. If a human wrote it, it is never set in mono.

rules.name: The Overlay-Only Shadow Rule
rules.body: A card at rest never carries a shadow. Shadow is reserved for content that must read as floating above the page.

dos: Do use the four accents only for their assigned meaning — reading, writing, destroying, doubting.
Do pair every color-coded state with a text label and, for trust states, a distinct shape.
Do set machine-authored/verifiable values in Spline Sans Mono; everything a human wrote in Albert Sans.
Do respect prefers-reduced-motion on every animation without exception.
Do use active-voice, verb-led button labels.
donts: Don't give a card, section, or badge a shadow at rest.
Don't introduce a fifth accent color or a new hue for any reason.
Don't use signal red as a filled button background anywhere except the one destructive-confirm control per flow.
